title: Do you see what I see? An Ambiguous Optical Illusion Dataset exposing limitations of Explainable AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image classification models and Explainable AI (XAI) algorithms on a dataset of ambiguous optical illusions to demonstrate that models rely heavily on pixel-level features rather than human-aligned abstract concepts (like gaze direction and eye coordinates).

Mitigating unintentional class-specific cues during the generation of the optical illusion dataset by iteratively prompting for diverse variations in animal poses, gaze directions, eye positions, and artistic styles to prevent models from learning spurious correlations.
